result.title: EchoAlign: Echocardiography foundation model with multilevel report alignment
result.comment: 33 pages, 3 figures, 6 extended data figures, 4 extended data tables. Code and model weights: https://github.com/BioMedIA-MBZUAI/EchoAlign
result.summary: Echocardiography assesses the structure and function of the heart. Cardiologists read each study across several standard views and report the findings visible in those views by cardiac structure. AI foundation models can learn to analyze these studies from clinical reports, reducing annotation burden and supporting clinical interpretation. However, existing models are trained by pairing each video with the full clinical report, including structures and findings its view does not show. This mismatch lets a model associate a finding with incidental or spurious signals rather than its visual evidence, which limits accuracy, anatomical grounding and clinical trust. Here we introduce EchoAlign, a vision-language foundation model developed on 2.87 million echocardiographic videos and images from 159 clinical centers. EchoAlign aligns each cardiac structure, video and study with its report text, and a visibility matrix restricts supervision to the views that actually depict each structure. We compare it with five public foundation models on 0.47 million test videos across ten unseen external datasets from more than 25 clinical centers. EchoAlign achieves the highest mean AUROC of 0.890 (95% CI, 0.881 to 0.897) for classification and the highest mean quadratic weighted kappa of 0.530 (95% CI, 0.511 to 0.544) for severity grading. Across 62 clinical findings, EchoAlign provides one model that detects findings, grades their severity, estimates measurements and segments cardiac structures.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 EchoAlign 超声心动图视觉语言基础模型，基于 287 万视频/图像按「心脏结构—视频—检查」三个层级与报告文本对齐，并用可见性矩阵把监督限制在真正显示该结构的视图上，在多个外部数据集上评估分类、严重程度分级、测量与分割。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按视图可见性裁剪监督、避免报告与视觉证据错配」的做法，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与监督贡献分配提供可核查线索，但论文本身不涉及 latent 推理状态。
